import pandas as pd

# Load both CSV files
ds = pd.read_csv('csv/driverStandings.csv')
races = pd.read_csv('csv/races.csv')

# Join on raceId, filter for Alex Yoong (driverId=62) and position < 20
result = ds.merge(races[['raceId', 'name']], on='raceId')
result = result[(result['driverId'] == 62) & (result['position'] < 20)]

# Get unique race names where Alex Yoong finished with position < 20
race_names = result['name'].unique().tolist()
print(race_names)
